pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, sharp-edged pixel gradients. Patches on the lower neck exhibit smaller relative spatial areas compared to the larger, more elongated polygons on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junctions consist of distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform with slight widening at junction vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
